meta.title: Lenix Wallet | Multi-Chain Crypto Wallet
meta.description: Non-custodial multi-chain wallet for send, receive, swap, and collateral loans — with encrypted local storage and a path to Lenix recovery when needed.
meta.keywords: Crypto Wallet, Multi-Chain Wallet, Non-Custodial Wallet, Lenix Wallet, Crypto Loans

Hero.title_mid: when you need it, from one
Hero.subtitle: A non-custodial wallet for everyday crypto — encrypted on your device, multi-chain by default, and connected to Lenix lending and recovery when the situation calls for more than a standard send.

Features.title: More than storage
Features.networks_line: Live on Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon.

encryption.title: Encrypted on device
encryption.desc: Keys are protected with a wallet password and stored locally — Lenix does not hold your seed phrase or signing keys.

multichain.title: Multi-chain balances
multichain.desc: View assets and history across Ethereum, BNB Chain, and Polygon from one wallet — switch networks without separate apps.

transfers.title: Send, receive, swap
transfers.desc: Move tokens, copy your receive address, and swap supported assets — with buy options where integrated providers are available.

loans.title: Collateral loans
loans.desc: Borrow stablecoins against supported assets without selling your position — terms and collateral ratios shown before you confirm.

recovery.title: Recovery pathway
recovery.desc: If assets are lost or stolen, open a recovery case from the Lenix ecosystem — tracing and exchange coordination when a standard wallet flow is not enough.

access.title: Web and mobile
access.desc: Use the browser wallet at lenixwallet.com or download the app — create once, import with your recovery phrase on either.

GettingStarted.title: Up and running in three steps

create.title: Create or import
create.desc: Generate a new wallet or restore with your 12- or 24-word recovery phrase.

secure.title: Set password and backup
secure.desc: Choose a wallet password and store your recovery phrase offline — Lenix cannot reset it for you.

use.title: Send, swap, or borrow
use.desc: Move assets, review history by chain, or open lending and recovery flows from the Lenix ecosystem.

Ecosystem.title: Wallet connects to the rest of the platform
Ecosystem.description: Hold assets here. When you need more than a transfer, follow the linked workflow.

Security.title: Security built in, not bolted on

keys.title: You hold the keys
keys.desc: Non-custodial by design. Funds move only when you sign — Lenix cannot freeze or redirect your wallet balance.

storage.title: Encrypted local storage
storage.desc: Wallet data is encrypted on your device. Unlock with your password; back up your recovery phrase offline.

access.title: Device-level unlock
access.desc: Add a password on setup and use device biometrics where supported — an extra gate before keys are used to sign.

Cta.title: Download Lenix Wallet
Cta.subtitle: Create or import a wallet in minutes. Same flows for send, receive, and swap — with lending and recovery in the Lenix ecosystem when you need them.
